1.name: TEXT_CTSMYCMEDAL_00719_RESISTANCECOUNCILOR_000_010
1.description: Good <hex:020843E3E90C0DFF1E02081AE3E90C05FF086576656E696E67FF0B64617920746F20796F7503FF1E02081AE3E90C12FF0B64617920746F20796F75FF086576656E696E670303>, Blade <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>. You have received all the accolades one might possibly earn from the Resistance, but if there is aught else I can do for you...
1.translation_description: <hex:020847E3E90C0DFF2002081CE3E90C05FF0A42756F6E6173657261FF0B42756F6E67696F726E6F03FF2002081CE3E90C12FF0B42756F6E67696F726E6FFF0A42756F6E61736572610303>, Lama <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>. Hai ricevuto tutte le onorificenze che si possono ottenere dalla Resistenza, ma se posso aiutarti in altro...

7.name: TEXT_CTSMYCMEDAL_00719_RESISTANCECOUNCILOR_000_100
7.description: My apologies, Blade <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>, but you are no longer eligible to receive proofs of mettle.
7.translation_description: Ti chiedo scusa, Lama <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>, ma non hai più diritto a ricevere prove di valore.

8.name: TEXT_CTSMYCMEDAL_00719_RESISTANCECOUNCILOR_000_101
8.description: I am afraid there are only so many honors one soldier can receive.
8.translation_description: Temo che un soldato possa ricevere solo un numero limitato di onorificenze.

9.name: TEXT_CTSMYCMEDAL_00719_RESISTANCECOUNCILOR_000_110
9.description: My apologies, Blade <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>, but you do not presently meet the requirements to receive proofs of mettle.
9.translation_description: Mi dispiace, Lama <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>, ma al momento non soddisfi i requisiti per ricevere prove di valore.

10.name: TEXT_CTSMYCMEDAL_00719_SYSTEM_000_111
10.description: At least <hex:022206E802FF022C03> mettle is required to receive proofs of mettle.
10.translation_description: Sono necessari almeno <hex:022206E802FF022C03> punti di valore per ricevere prove di valore.

11.name: TEXT_CTSMYCMEDAL_00719_RESISTANCECOUNCILOR_000_120
11.description: You wish to receive proofs of mettle? Then let us have a look at your combat records.
11.translation_description: Vuoi ricevere prove di valore? Allora esaminiamo i tuoi rapporti di battaglia.

12.name: TEXT_CTSMYCMEDAL_00719_Q2_000_000
12.description: You have currently amassed <hex:022206E802FF022C03> mettle.<hex:02100103>Expend <hex:022206E803FF022C03> mettle to receive <hex:022003E80403> proof<hex:02080AE2E80402FF01FF027303> of mettle?
12.translation_description: Al momento hai accumulato <hex:022206E802FF022C03> punti di valore.<hex:02100103>Vuoi spendere <hex:022206E803FF022C03> punti di valore per ricevere <hex:022003E80403> prov<hex:02080BE2E80402FF0261FF026503> di valore?

13.name: TEXT_CTSMYCMEDAL_00719_RESISTANCECOUNCILOR_000_130
13.description: A reward well earned, I must say.

14.name: TEXT_CTSMYCMEDAL_00719_RESISTANCECOUNCILOR_000_135
14.description: When you have made your decision, speak with me again that we might discuss which honors you wish to receive.
14.translation_description: Quando avrai deciso, parlami di nuovo: discuteremo delle onorificenze che desideri ottenere.

15.name: TEXT_CTSMYCMEDAL_00719_RESISTANCECOUNCILOR_000_140
15.description: Though I have not witnessed it with my own eyes, I have heard tales of what one might accomplish with the blessings of these accolades. You would do well to earn more if greater glory on the battlefield is what you seek.
15.translation_description: Non l’ho visto con i miei occhi, ma ho sentito raccontare ciò che si può fare grazie alle benedizioni di queste onorificenze. Ti conviene guadagnarne altre se cerchi maggiore gloria sul campo di battaglia.

16.name: TEXT_CTSMYCMEDAL_00719_RESISTANCECOUNCILOR_000_145
16.description: There is not a soldier in all of the Resistance that has yet to hear of your accomplishments. Indeed, our historians are quite eager to chronicle the ventures of Blade <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>, war hero and liberator of Bozja.
16.translation_description: Nessun soldato della Resistenza ignora le tue imprese. I nostri storici non vedono l’ora di raccontare le gesta di Lama <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>, eroe di guerra e liberatore di Bozja.

17.name: TEXT_CTSMYCMEDAL_00719_RESISTANCECOUNCILOR_000_210
17.description: Excellent! Which honors do you wish to receive?

18.name: TEXT_CTSMYCMEDAL_00719_Q3_000_000
18.description: Which Resistance honors will you receive?<hex:02100103>(Proof<hex:02080AE2E80202FF01FF027303> of Mettle: <hex:022003E80203>)
18.translation_description: Quali onorificenze della Resistenza vuoi ricevere?<hex:02100103>(Prov<hex:02080BE2E80202FF0261FF026503> di valore: <hex:022003E80203>)

19.name: TEXT_CTSMYCMEDAL_00719_A3_000_000
19.description: Sun of Fortitude (<hex:022003E80203>/<hex:022003E80303>) | Required Proof<hex:02080AE2E80402FF01FF027303> of Mettle: <hex:022003E80403>
19.translation_description: Sole della Fortezza (<hex:022003E80203>/<hex:022003E80303>) | Costo in prov<hex:02080BE2E80402FF0261FF026503> di valore: <hex:022003E80403>

20.name: TEXT_CTSMYCMEDAL_00719_A3_000_001
20.description: Sun of Valor (<hex:022003E80203>/<hex:022003E80303>) | Required Proof<hex:02080AE2E80402FF01FF027303> of Mettle: <hex:022003E80403>
20.translation_description: Sole del Valore (<hex:022003E80203>/<hex:022003E80303>) | Costo in prov<hex:02080BE2E80402FF0261FF026503> di valore: <hex:022003E80403>

21.name: TEXT_CTSMYCMEDAL_00719_A3_000_002
21.description: Sun of Succor (<hex:022003E80203>/<hex:022003E80303>) | Required Proof<hex:02080AE2E80402FF01FF027303> of Mettle: <hex:022003E80403>
21.translation_description: Sole del Soccorso (<hex:022003E80203>/<hex:022003E80303>) | Costo in prov<hex:02080BE2E80402FF0261FF026503> di valore: <hex:022003E80403>

23.name: TEXT_CTSMYCMEDAL_00719_RESISTANCECOUNCILOR_000_230
23.description: My apologies, Blade <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>, but you require more proofs of mettle to receive such an honor.
23.translation_description: Mi dispiace, Lama <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>, ma ti servono altre prove di valore per ricevere quest’onorificenza.

24.name: TEXT_CTSMYCMEDAL_00719_RESISTANCECOUNCILOR_000_061
24.description: If you have amassed sufficient mettle, we may speak again about any additional proofs you require.
24.translation_description: Se hai accumulato abbastanza valore, potremo discutere delle altre prove di cui hai bisogno.

25.name: TEXT_CTSMYCMEDAL_00719_Q4_000_000
25.description: Receive a Sun of Fortitude in exchange for <hex:022003E80203> proof<hex:02080AE2E80202FF01FF027303> of mettle?
25.translation_description: Vuoi scambiare <hex:022003E80203> prov<hex:02080BE2E80202FF0261FF026503> di valore per un Sole della Fortezza?

26.name: TEXT_CTSMYCMEDAL_00719_Q4_000_001
26.description: Receive a Sun of Valor in exchange for <hex:022003E80203> proof<hex:02080AE2E80202FF01FF027303> of mettle?
26.translation_description: Vuoi scambiare <hex:022003E80203> prov<hex:02080BE2E80202FF0261FF026503> di valore per un Sole del Valore?

27.name: TEXT_CTSMYCMEDAL_00719_Q4_000_002
27.description: Receive a Sun of Succor in exchange for <hex:022003E80203> proof<hex:02080AE2E80202FF01FF027303> of mettle?
27.translation_description: Vuoi scambiare <hex:022003E80203> prov<hex:02080BE2E80202FF0261FF026503> di valore per un Sole del Soccorso?

28.name: TEXT_CTSMYCMEDAL_00719_RESISTANCECOUNCILOR_000_250
28.description: Yes, this is the requisite number of proofs. On behalf of the Resistance, it is my honor and privilege to award you this Resistance honor.
28.translation_description: Sì, hai raccolto un numero sufficiente di prove. A nome della Resistenza, è per me un onore e un privilegio conferirti questa onorificenza.

29.name: TEXT_CTSMYCMEDAL_00719_RESISTANCECOUNCILOR_000_251
29.description: May it offer you the courage and protection needed to overcome all who would oppose you, and serve to enhearten those who might fight at your side.
29.translation_description: Possa offrirti il coraggio e la protezione necessari per superare chiunque ti si opponga, e incoraggiare chi combatterà al tuo fianco.

30.name: TEXT_CTSMYCMEDAL_00719_RESISTANCECOUNCILOR_000_270
30.description: If I am not mistaken, Blade <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>, you have now received all honors one might earn in service to the Resistance.
30.translation_description: Se non erro, Lama <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>, hai ricevuto tutte le onorificenze ottenibili al servizio della Resistenza.

31.name: TEXT_CTSMYCMEDAL_00719_RESISTANCECOUNCILOR_000_271
31.description: In all my time with the Resistance, no soldier has shown such dedication to our cause.
31.translation_description: In tutto il tempo che ho trascorso nella Resistenza, nessun soldato ha mai dimostrato una dedizione così grande alla nostra causa.

32.name: TEXT_CTSMYCMEDAL_00719_RESISTANCECOUNCILOR_000_272
32.description: We could never hope to repay all you have done for us, but know that, so long as Bozja stands, her people shall never forget the hero to whom they owe their freedom.
32.translation_description: Non potremo mai ripagarti per tutto ciò che hai fatto per noi. Ma sappi che, finché Bozja resterà in piedi, il suo popolo non dimenticherà mai l’eroe a cui deve la propria libertà.

33.name: TEXT_CTSMYCMEDAL_00719_SYSTEM_000_273
33.description: You have been awarded full honors for your contributions to the Resistance!
33.translation_description: Hai ricevuto tutte le onorificenze per il tuo contributo alla Resistenza!
